name: Necromancer: animated Skeletal Archers keep their bows drawn (#8557)
contract: Animate: Skeletal Archer 805040 triggers 500330, which summons three Skeletal Archers (creature 50076)
carrying bows in their ranged equipment slots. An archer holds its bow only while its sheath state is
ranged (2); the melee state used by default for creatures without an addon leaves the hands empty
because the archers own no melee weapon. Every archer must therefore be ranged-sheathed when it is
animated and stay so while idle out of combat. A second nearby Necromancer owns none of these archers.
This covers the server sheath state, not rendered client animations.

steps.label: Every animated archer holds its bow drawn
No animated archer has its melee sheath ready
The nearby player owns no drawn archers
Idle archers out of combat keep their bows drawn
